== Strategy ==

I guess I should give some strategy text here, as it's not too obvious. First off, I will tell everyone that Paul Todd Feldman designed the core of this Deck. The similarities are apparent. I modified it, with essential help from Robert Hallaman Jr. I would like to take a moment to give my utmost thanks to Robert, as without him, I'm not sure if I would have won the regional -- he was a great help with strategy ideas, deck editing and stuff like that. Thanks Rob.

Anyway, onto strategy...Start with the Dagobah system, so you get all the sites out by turn 5. On the 2nd turn, you will have a minimum of 11 cards in your hand, so you should have SOS or Yoda. Activate your 5 force (Or more, depending on Dark Side Locations) and deploy Yoda or SOS to the Hut as soon as possible. This allows you now to Sense or Alter anything your opponent tries.

From here on, use the Dagobah and Training Area game text to search your deck, so you know what's in your Force pile, thus telling you if you need to draw or not. When you get Yoda and SOS out, deploy Great Warrior, and train Luke.

You'll need a destiny of 2, which is pretty easy. Now your opponent will have weakened Force drains, especially on the ground.

Now you want to cause your opponent damage. Get your Revolutions out along with Sabers, to cause a maximum drain of 6 per turn...not too shabby. Use your Ships/Landing Claws/R2/Undercover to stop a maximum of 3 of your opponents drains. With the Great Warrior Game Text, he shouldn't be draining you for more than 6 per turn. Even if he is, don't worry. You can use On The Edge to get 6 Force back each time, and then you can also cause him to lose Force by Sense or Altering anything he plays.

Basically, you drain for 6 per turn, cancel any stuff he does, slow his drains, and retrieve Force...not much the opponent can do.
